# Prometeus — key visual / dashboard exploration
Source: approved docs/brandbook/design-system.md + design-system.json, version 1.0.0, 2026-09-26. This is an exploration, not a change to canonical runtime tokens.

## Essence
Tecnologia que amplia pessoas. Technological, precise, human, confident. Quiet dark depth, clean hierarchy, selective blue emphasis and excellent legibility. Brazilian Portuguese. Product name Prometeus.

## Creative freedom
The user explicitly authorizes original layouts and new component compositions. Existing components are inspiration, not templates or constraints. Explore an editorial command center with an expressive executive summary, varied visual hierarchy, generous whitespace and intelligent data visualization. Avoid repetitive grids of identical boxed cards. No landing-page hero, photographic filler, decorative stock imagery or invented mascot.

## Color system — exact brand tokens
Canvas midnight #040814. Action blue #0652C5 with white text #FFFFFF.
Supporting institutional colors navy #1A2338, slate #3B4B6B, mist #E2E8F0.
Runtime surfaces #0B101E and #111727. Muted text #9CA7BA. Readable links/focus #88B8FC (never use action blue as small text on midnight).
Thin subtle separators; opaque dark panels and overlays. Restrained blue illumination at 9% maximum on canvas. No warm cream, white glass, purple or teal as brand colors.
Semantic status colors may use amber, red and green ONLY with explicit status labels. Do not rainbow-code every chart. Charts distinguish series by direct labels and line patterns, not only hue. Prefer blue, mist and slate data graphics.

## Typography
Space Grotesk for interface, headings and numeric metrics, weights 400/500/600/700. Geist Mono for technical metadata only. Tabular lining figures for comparable numbers.
Title 32/40, section 24/32, body 16/24, labels 14/20, metadata 12/16. Solid readable body text; silver gradient allowed only in opening heading sparingly.

## Geometry and interaction
4px spacing rhythm: 4 8 12 16 24 32 48 64. 16px mobile outer margin, 32 desktop, generous section rhythm.
Rounded 8/10/12/16px corners with deliberate variation; pills only for badges. 1px borders, restrained shadows. No nested card clutter.
44px touch targets, visible focus, explicit labels. Error/empty/loading/partial states are meaningful. WCAG AA contrast target; respect reduced motion. Desktop 1440 and mobile 390 down to 320, no horizontal page overflow, mobile content reordered by decision priority.

## Original logo artwork
Use supplied original artwork below as an image, keep its 322:88 aspect ratio, transparency, 160px display width and clearspace. Do NOT retype the word as a new logo, do NOT draw a replacement symbol. If embedding is unsupported leave a reserved asset slot, never invent an emblem.
![Prometeus original logo](data:image/png;base64,)

## Mascot
Original robot is preserved in existing chat with its two speech bubbles. This dashboard need not include it. Do not generate a replacement robot.

## Data honesty
All screen values are explicit fictitious demo data. Missing data is NOT zero. No false API-connected or CRM-connected claims. Sales closed during period differ from cumulative conversion of leads acquired during period. Paid cost per qualified lead uses only paid-channel qualified leads. Manual email/WhatsApp results weekly via Hermes, per campaign and calendar action, with reviewed confirmation before future persistence. Current output is a visual concept only.
